About.title: Our Story
About.intro: BagajPark helps you shed the heavy load while you travel—it’s Türkiye’s widest local luggage storage network.
About.visionBody: To build a digital storage network where every traveler can safely leave their belongings, in every corner of Türkiye.
About.missionBody: Combine local businesses’ unused space with technology—freedom for travelers, extra income for partners.
About.value1Desc: We work hand in hand with local partners.
About.value2Desc: Sealed luggage system for full protection.

KVKK.subtitle: Under Law No. 6698
KVKK.section1Body: As BagajPark Technology Inc., we commit to processing your data as the "Data Controller" under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.
KVKK.purpose3: Sending notifications and announcements to users
KVKK.section3Body: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information if it is, and request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data. You can contact us at kvkk@bagajpark.com.

Terms.section1Body: This User Agreement sets out the rights and obligations between BagajPark Technology Inc. and Guests and Business Partners (storage points) using the platform. It is based on the "Storage Agreement" (Turkish Civil Code 561–580).
Terms.section2Body: BagajPark undertakes to compensate up to 5,000 TRY per bag for damage, loss, or theft. The platform is not liable for items above this value (cash, jewelry, electronics, etc.).

Privacy.section1Body: At BagajPark, we put the security of your personal data first. Any information you share while using the platform is protected with strong encryption (AES-256).
Privacy.section3Body: We use essential cookies for the platform to work, session management, and recommending suitable storage points. We also use anonymous analytics cookies to improve your experience.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Quick answers to everything you're curious about.
FAQ.a1: Yes, every bag is insured up to 5,000 TL and sealed upon drop-off.
FAQ.a2: You have the right to free cancellation up to 24 hours before your drop-off time.
FAQ.a3: For your security, all payments are made digitally through our platform.
FAQ.q4: What if the storage point is closed?
